title: kith-jmap: JmapHandler panics crash task with no serverFail response
description: JmapHandler::call and PeerJmapHandler::call docs explicitly note panics propagate through the async executor and crash the task with no catch at the dispatch layer. A single panicking handler tears down the HTTP connection without sending a serverFail response to the client. For the peer path, a malformed Peer/deliver could trigger a handler bug and silently drop the connection. Consider wrapping handler.call().await in AssertUnwindSafe+catch_unwind and returning a serverFail invocation on catch.
